model_choice_evidence: 2020 paper DOI 10.1002/we.2543 section 2.3, calibrated upwind pitch -0.75 degrees; the older website still names v1.

local_frame.origin: ground vertically below the benchmark rotor centre
local_frame.y: crosswind, right-handed with x and z
local_frame.z: up, metres above flat benchmark ground
local_frame.note: A normalized benchmark frame, not an ENU or UTM frame and not an observed event heading.

geographic_reference_only.base_vertical_datum: not specified in benchmark site-layout page
geographic_reference_only.note: Site location only. No geographic DEM, buildings or surveyed mast position have been reconstructed.

proposed_domain_m.status: autonomous starting proposal; requires domain sensitivity before use

sampling_marker_status: benchmark output reference x=-65 m, approximately -2.5D; not a surveyed real mast location
scene_limitations: Flat ground is the published benchmark idealization, not downloaded topography.
Tower profile comes from the v3 AeroDyn model; ground to tower top 31 m.
Rotor reference is a vertical zero-thickness disk at z=32.1 m, not blades or a wall. Tilt and overhang must be reconciled when building forcing.
No nacelle shape or dimensions are invented. No other turbines or buildings are added.
The upstream reference marker is symbolic and must not be included as a CFD solid.
No aerodynamic or electromagnetic material properties are assigned by this geometry.
